decision: Paper-1 uses the complete reproducible public repository artifact and names it ES-MemEval-Public-v1.0.0-1427. It does not claim row-identical reproduction of the WWW 2026 final-paper 1209 QA set.
rationale: The final 1209 row IDs are unavailable in the inspected paper, public repository history, and issue tracker.
The local file exactly matches the official public v1.0.0 file hash.
Selecting all 1427 public rows is outcome-blind, deterministic, broader than an undocumented subset, and independently reproducible.
Waiting for an unpublished identity is not required for a valid external task if the artifact and claim are named precisely.

formal_paper_boundary.allowed_wording: Evaluation on ES-MemEval-Public-v1.0.0-1427, the complete public artifact associated with ES-MemEval.
formal_paper_boundary.forbidden_wording: Exact reproduction of the final-paper 1209-question ES-MemEval QA benchmark.

historical_418_boundary: The historical project-specific 418-question V5.2 slice remains diagnostic only and cannot replace the frozen 1427-row primary task.
